subject: POC MAP: Launch-prep action slate (env setup, API keys, peering)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@medcure.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC MAP: Launch-prep action slate (env setup, API keys, peering)

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to kick off the POC with MedCure. Attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the environment handoff scope we discussed: org bootstrap, API key issuance, IP allowlist, and VPC peering.

High-level asks from Redwood to MedCure to unblock the first 10 business days:
- Provide primary networking contact and VPC ID for peering (see network-diagram-stub.pdf).
- Share CIDR/IP ranges for API allowlist (we need at least two /24s or a list of fixed IPs).
- Confirm org domain to create the MedCure tenant and preferred admin(s).
- Sign the short SOW to authorize dedicated peering window (DocuSign link to follow).

I've assigned internal owners below so you know who's doing what on our side. Please let us know which of the listed deadlines you can meet; we're flexible but target the week of July 8 for an integration dry-run.

Internal owners (Redwood):
- Ben Carter: VPC peering (network schedule + routing)
- Marissa Cole: Tenant/org setup & API key provisioning
- Vanessa Ortiz: Program lead, MAP cadence and escalation

Attachments: map-poc-environment-v1.xlsx (MAP checklist), network-diagram-stub.pdf

Next steps: if you can confirm the networking contact and a preferred peering date window by end of day Wednesday, Ben will propose two 2-hour windows for the peering work.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

---

From: Elena Torres <elena@medcure.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Reed <alex.reed@medcure.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP: Launch-prep action slate (env setup, API keys, peering)

Vanessa,

Thanks — the MAP looks good at first read. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Networking contact: Alex Reed (cc'd) will own the peering details.
- VPC info: we can share our VPC ID and the list of egress IPs, but we need a brief template (preferred JSON or CSV) for the allowlist to avoid back-and-forth.
- API keys: are these long-lived keys for the POC or ephemeral tokens? For security we prefer scoped, time-limited credentials if possible.
- SOW: we need the SOW to go through procurement; can you confirm the SOW will only cover peering and the initial 30-day eval?

We can commit to the requested week of July 8 for the dry-run if we get the peering windows by Thursday July 4.

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Integrations, MedCure
elena@medcure.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@medcure.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP: Launch-prep action slate (env setup, API keys, peering)

Elena — great, thanks for the quick reply and for looping Alex. Short answers inline and then a compact action slate.

- Allowlist template: attached MAP includes a small CSV template (CIDR / IP, purpose). I also pasted a minimal example below so Alex can drop values directly:
  customer_cidr, purpose
  198.51.100.0/24, POC_API_ALLOW
  203.0.113.45, POC_EPHEMERAL_WORKER

- API keys: for the POC we provision scoped keys with a 30-day TTL by default. If you need ephemeral tokens (rotating) we can enable short-lived tokens via the console and share an automation script. Marissa will coordinate.

- SOW scope: yes — the SOW is limited to the POC peering, one dedicated peering window (two-hour maintenance window), and support for initial onboarding. No additional services are included. Procurement language will be short-form; I'll send to you and procurement once you confirm.

Action slate (owners & target dates):
- MedCure provide: VPC ID + CIDR/IP allowlist + networking contact (requested by 2028-07-03) — OWNER: MedCure (Elena/Alex)
- Redwood: create tenant & seed org admins + provision POC API keys (target 2028-07-05) — OWNER: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
- Redwood: schedule peering window and runbook; execute peering (target proposed windows 2028-07-08 or 2028-07-09) — OWNER: ben_carter@redwood.ai
- Both: dry-run integration test (application calls to API) (target 2028-07-10) — OWNER: mutual

Ben/Marissa: please confirm your availability for the proposed dates and add any checklist items to the attached MAP spreadsheet.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: map-poc-environment-v1.xlsx

Subject: Re: POC MAP: Launch-prep action slate (env setup, API keys, peering)

Elena / Vanessa,

I can take the peering runbook and schedule. Two quick asks from my side:
1) Please confirm the MedCure VPC ID and the account number (we'll need those for the console request).
2) Provide a primary networking contact with an outage window preference (we usually propose 02:00–04:00 UTC to minimize impact, but happy to work with your ops).

I'll target July 8 and July 9 as candidate peering windows and will post two slots once I get the VPC and contact. I'll also attach the minimal runbook to the HubSpot record and paste it into the MAP spreadsheet.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
